flags.effect: Folders to search for repositories (default: the source folders of `sources root ls`, else the usual checkout folders)
flags.name: --roots

flags.effect: Tick a thing you carry yourself: browser, keys, licenses, outside (repeatable)
flags.name: --tick

flags.effect: Acknowledge a finding by its id (repeatable)
flags.name: --ack

summary: Before a reset: unpushed work, repositories without a remote, changes and stashes, plus the things you carry yourself (--roots, --tick, --untick, --ack)
